description: Your whole Garmin history in a local database, not one 28-day page at a time.

novel_features.name: Sleep over a window, joined and compared
novel_features.description: Duration, score, stage split and resting heart rate for a window of nights, with the equally long window before it beside them.

novel_features.name: Training load, zone split and fitness trend in one read
novel_features.description: Archived activities grouped by type with their time and distance, time summed per heart-rate zone, weekly load buckets, and the VO2-max and readiness trends beside them.

novel_features.name: Oldest-first archive fill of the 28-day-capped series
novel_features.description: Fills a local SQLite archive of every Garmin daily series from the oldest day forward, keeping one bookmark per series so an interrupted run resumes instead of restarting.

novel_features.name: Loopback browser login with identity assertion
novel_features.description: Refuses to store a token whose account is not the address you named, so a shared browser cannot sign the wrong household member in.
